dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a deep concave curvature (falcate) fitting a smooth parabolic spline from the dorsal insertion to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Apex is characterized by a rounded shape classification with a medium pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Leading edge shows an approximately 55-degree angular steepness relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical height ratio is approximately 1.1:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Melon exhibits high structural convexity with a tight radius curve creating a bulbous anterior profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Rostrum is very short and blunt with a low length-to-thickness ratio, appearing nearly continuous with the melon profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: A discernible obtuse interior angle is visible where the steep melon slope transitions into the short rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear white scarring (rake marks) and circular depigmented lesions are visible across the flank and dorsal surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive blunt, squared cranial morphology and heavy mottling pattern across the anterior-lateral region.
